name: 4.7-stable
body:
**Godot 4.7** is a feature release improving upon the previous version in many aspects, such as usability and performance. Feature releases also contain new features, but preserve compatibility with previous releases.

Report bugs on GitHub after checking that they haven't been reported:
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues

- [Release notes](https://godotengine.org/releases/4.7/)
